tests.title: Review and reverse AI time descriptions at the exact row scope
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need generated descriptions previewed and reversible without altering measured work or approving an invoice.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use three synthetic activity rows: one selected, one already approved and one being edited concurrently. Generate for one and then all; show the exact target IDs, original text, proposed text and generation version. Bulk work cannot overwrite a newer edit or an approved value without an explicit reviewed transition. Regenerate creates a new attributable suggestion; revert restores the selected original text rather than an unrelated group title. Preserve raw duration, user, matter, rate, billability and source-event links. A provider timeout leaves existing text intact. Generate/revert never invoices or sends a client copy. Preserve approved attorney-letter voice/date rules wherever letter content is used as context.

tests.title: Reconcile immediate and overnight time conversion runs
tests.developer_story_extension: As the reviewer, I need immediate, overnight and retroactive conversion to converge on one traceable ledger rather than duplicate charges.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: For a selected date/user seed three captured events and a late manually entered activity. Run an immediate job, retry its provider acknowledgement, run overnight, then add the late activity and run again. Each eligible source version maps once to a derived fee, with new late work added separately and source corrections handled as reviewed revisions. A different date/user run cannot claim the selected set was finalized. Show pending, queued, accepted, persisted and failed states separately. The summary email reconciles the exact run population; receiving an email does not prove every source was ingested, an invoice sent or a bill paid.

tests.title: Preserve document identity when migrating a Word index
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need document, email and note migration to preserve originals and matter lineage instead of treating an index import as verified organization.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use synthetic files with duplicate names, two versions, stale Word hyperlinks and one document linked to two matters. Import an index plus underlying bytes with hashes, source locations and original dates; flag broken links, ambiguous matter matches and missing originals. Replaying the import does not duplicate assets, and permissioned multi-matter links do not silently copy confidential content. Reconcile source item counts, originals, versions, matter links and unresolved entries before approving migration. The independent user testimonial motivates this case; it does not prove a vendor migration API, current onboarding entitlement or completed import.
